decision: The interior is the datum. The shell is fitted to it, because game/index.html hard-codes lift shafts and waypoints in model coordinates and moving the geometry would silently desync them.

transform.y: lowered so the shell's OWN floor lands on L1, not its bounding-box base. Measured: the shell's internal floor sits at a median 2.52 m above the base of its bounding box, so aligning boxes put L1's floor 2.52 m BELOW the shell's floor and the player's eye, at 1.86 m, underneath it. See tools/measure_shell_floor.py.

with_aprons.note: aprons are outdoor pavement and sit outside the shell by design

verified: every above-ground node except the aprons is inside the fitted shell
known_mismatch: our L1 floor -> L3 deck is 69.90 m against the shell's 67.71 m of clear height, so with the floors aligned our L3 deck plate sits about 2.2 m above the shell's deck. Fixing that needs either a 3.3% vertical squash of the interior or a 3.3% stretch of the shell; neither has been done, because one changes every level height and the other changes the perfect model.
